content: Finally, note that it is not feasible to evaluate a full range of available pretrained encoders within the scope of this work. Our main intention is to provide the first set of baseline results on Multi-SimLex by benchmarking a sample of most popular encoders, at the same time also investigating other important questions such as performance of static versus contextualized word embeddings, or multilingual versus language-specific pretraining. Another purpose of the experiments is to outline the wide potential and applicability of the Multi-SimLex datasets for multilingual and cross-lingual representation learning evaluation.
